Those headings already contain en-dashes in published copy, for example 'Rule 2 - Client money separation' with an en-dash. The extra counts are therefore duplicates of body text already inside the ceiling, not new copy: sra-accounts-rules-essentials went 21 to 53, and its two TOC blocks carry 16 dashes each, which accounts for the 32 exactly. The owner's hard rule of 2026-09-11 forbids rewriting the headings, so the ceiling is restated rather than the copy changed. No other route moved. Correction to that sentence: /blog/practice-accounting also moved, 1 to 0, because the pre-port page serialised a fatter client payload whose serialised post fields carried the dash; the phase 3 projection drops those fields from the payload, so the character no longer appears in the page source.
